title: AI Team Headshots for Your About Page | AIVideosUGC
description: Make matching team headshots in one shared light, crop and backdrop, each from a teammate's own photo. AI portraits for About and team pages.
h1: AI Team Headshots That Match Across the Page
lead: A team page looks unfinished when every portrait has a different crop and light. Upload each approved photo and get matching AI team headshots.

steps.d: Upload an approved face-and-shoulders photo with even light and nothing covering the face. Confirm the person agreed to this business use before you upload.
Describe one backdrop, crop, light and clothing note, then reuse that brief for every teammate. Each portrait should still keep that person's own features.
Download each portrait for the team page, deck or profile. Add names and roles as text beside the portraits, not inside them.

maker.upload_title: Drop a photo of the person here

faq.a: A recent face-and-shoulders photo with even light, and no hat, sunglasses or hand covering the face. Use a photo that person has approved for the company to upload.

faq.q: How can the team page feel consistent?
faq.a: Share one backdrop, one crop and one light across every portrait, while each person keeps their own features. Write the brief once and reuse it.

faq.q: Can I put names inside the headshot?
faq.a: Add names and job titles as text beside each image. Keeping them out of the portrait makes a role change a text edit, not a new generation.

faq.q: Will this match a specific person exactly?
faq.a: No. It follows the features visible in the uploaded photo, and it is still a generated portrait, not an official identity document. Have that person review it before you publish.

faq.q: What does a team headshot cost?
faq.a: Each photo costs 24 credits, the cost is shown before you start, and a failed job returns those credits. The download has no watermark, and you can use it in your own ads, pages and posts. Plan sizes are listed on [AIVideosUGC pricing](page:pricing).

faq.q: Do I need permission from each teammate?
faq.a: Yes. Upload only a photo the person agreed you can use for this business purpose, and let them approve the final portrait.

faq.q: Can a new hire match an existing set?
faq.a: Yes. Reuse the same backdrop, crop and light brief on the new hire's approved photo. You do not reshoot the rest of the team.

faq.q: Can I use the portraits in a pitch deck?
faq.a: Yes. The square file can sit on an About page, a profile or a slide. Keep contact details as text next to the image.

cta_lead: Upload an approved photo for each person. You see the credit cost before the job starts.

steps.prompt: Make a square portrait from the uploaded person with a soft gray backdrop and even light.
